half: discovery — graded separately from routing correctness (see evals.json)
method: No probe mentions the skill, a skill, the vault's artifact layout, or the words playbook/procedure except where the probe itself is an explicit which-playbook question. Activation is the harness's decision from the description alone. Every probe carries an identical read-only constraint.
activation_instrument: SKILLS_USED self-report plus output fingerprints (Entry/Exit vocabulary, the confirm-before-invoking question, the playbooks/<name>/ path form). Not harness instrumentation. Self-report has proven unreliable in both directions, so counts are a floor.
